findings.finding: Current no-login deployment cannot produce authenticated broker/identity/independent NAV authority.
findings.designDisposition: Preserve block. Owner may separately evaluate trust mechanism; never substitute JSON/OS/Codex/synthetic identities.

findings.finding: B1–B4leave current economic ownership/claims/obligations unresolved; opening integrity is not forward completeness.
findings.designDisposition: Preserve null full NAV/indicative; exact external records and accepted reconciliation required.

findings.finding: CurrentNavResultV1permissions literalfalse and only test/research origins; copying to official dashboard conflicts with contract.
findings.designDisposition: Separate proposed publication envelope/amendment, explicit owner review before any implementation. Do not mutate V1.

findings.finding: TCBS runtime composition permits VALUATION, not PORTFOLIO_NAV.
findings.designDisposition: Separate NAV-purpose source/finality/calendar acceptance and read adapter; preserve existing approvals unchanged.

findings.finding: Synchronous verifier and evidenceHead alone do not establish async current human authority or atomic publication across stores.
findings.designDisposition: Preverified immutable scoped authority view and whole dependency token; final current-head check atP, deny on any uncertainty.

findings.finding: Acceptance cannot sign a resultHash that already contains the same acceptance proof.
findings.designDisposition: Accept canonical input subject without its own receipt; calculate result, then separate operational decision binds resultHash.

findings.finding: TCBS master from=knownAt date and local technical calendar are not accepted effective/continuity/finality witnesses.
findings.designDisposition: Require external dated account/market identity and calendar/finality sources; no inferred mapping date.

findings.finding: Technical/read-only usability does not supersede real-money release restrictions, unapplied migrations or proposed registry status.
findings.designDisposition: B6/B7and distinct operational/release decisions remain mandatory; no deployment authorized.

findings.finding: Adapter/publication reasons are not implemented and broker account evidence is sensitive.
findings.designDisposition: Label proposed reason namespace, expose opaque IDs/safe error reasons; protected raw evidence and no credentials in manifests/logs.
